question: Why does the person's harness report 'expense-tracker: failed (codemode, global) http://127.0.0.1:3020/mcp — MCP server requires authentication'?
probes: Run `pi mcp list` and read the exact status/error
Compare tokens in data/mcp.json, OpenCode global config and Pi's mcp.json
POST /mcp with each token and compare HTTP status
resolution: The exact error came from Pi (`pi mcp list` printed the person's message verbatim). Pi's ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json held a stale bearer token (et_2f67...), while the running server and data/mcp.json use et_401e... (POST /mcp returned 401 for the stale token and 200 for the current one; OpenCode's global config already had the current token). Replaced the stale token in Pi's config with the current one. Verified: `pi mcp list` now reports 'expense-tracker: connected, 6 tools (codemode, global)' and POST /mcp with the synced token returns HTTP 200. rebuild_check still passes (cargo build/test). Remaining limit: the live process serves 6 tools because it is an older binary; the source and on-disk binary already contain update_transaction (7th tool), visible only after the server is restarted.
